text:
sophia: Bringing up orion-v2-lite on staging, seeing weird detokenization in a single response that mixes vertical Japanese ruby text and an Arabic RTL quote. Anyone seen this? :eyes:
raj: Can you paste a minimal repro and the tokenizer config?
sophia: Yep, minimal input below (from our bilingual sample set):
```
日本語の縦書きルビ付きテキスト。
«مرحبا بالعالم»
```
sophia: Model output (staged q5_0 quant):
```
日本語の縦書きルビ付きテキスト.«مرحبا بالعالم»
```
raj: Hmm the Arabic quotes lost their bidi isolation and got glued to the Japanese sentence. Is this detok or tokenization?
elaine: Which tokenizer was used on the orion-v2-lite build? Did we fall back to the legacy byte-pair mapping?
sophia: Tokenizer: `redwood-tokenizer-v3` + small custom merges for vertical punctuation. Quant: `q5_0-fast` (no per-channel).
yun: Could be a detok normalization step dropping U+200E/U+200F markers or ZWJ/ZWNJ differences. Any diffs vs mainline?
sophia: Ran a quick diff vs last good commit:
```
git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/main
# shows 1 new merge touching detok/normalizer.js
```
kevin: On our bilingual eval, BLEU dropped ~3.6 for ja/ar pairs and chrF -0.07 on the same split. That's statistically significant for this small set.
raj: Can you paste the raw token sequence around the boundary?
sophia: Raw tokens (ids): `... 8421 0 0 1345 990 ...` where 0 is the whitespace/zero-width token in the quantized vocab.
elaine: 0 used to be ZWSP placeholder in v2 tokenizer; looks like merge changed mapping so ZWSP -> 0 got reused. That would collapse boundaries.
yun: Quick test idea: re-run detok with explicit insertion of U+200D between scripts and see if output re-separates. If it does, bad mapping.
sophia: I did a quick script, inserted U+200D and output is fixed (quotes separated).
sophia: Repro steps I ran:
```bash
# reproduce on staging
python ./tools/repro_tokenization.py \
  --model orion-v2-lite \
  --quant q5_0-fast \
  --input samples/ja_ar_mixed.txt \
  --show-tokens
```
sophia: attaching sample lines to the ticket when I open it.
deploy-bot: Deployment orion-v2-lite (staging) succeeded at 2801234578.
raj: Priority: P1 for multilingual detok regression. Please open a regression ticket linking the exact commit and attach the bilingual eval results.
sophia: Will open ticket now and assign to eng-ml/tokenization + eng-ml/quantization.
kevin: Also add a short eval harness run (1000 ja/ar pairs) with BLEU/chrF and token boundary counts so we can track the fix.
sophia: On it. I'll post ticket number and a short test artifact here. :thumbsup:
